abilities.name: DEATHBRINGER STANCE
abilities.description: Periodically, Aatrox's next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and heals him, based on the target's max health.

abilities.name: THE DARKIN BLADE
abilities.description: Aatrox slams his greatsword down, dealing physical damage. He can swing three times, each with a different area of effect.

abilities.name: INFERNAL CHAINS
abilities.description: Aatrox smashes the ground, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.

abilities.name: UMBRAL DASH
abilities.description: Passively, Aatrox heals when damaging enemy champions. On activation, he dashes in a direction.

abilities.name: WORLD ENDER
abilities.description: Aatrox unleashes his demonic form, fearing nearby enemy minions and gaining attack damage, increased healing, and Move Speed. If he gets a takedown, this effect is extended.

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.description: Whenever Ahri hits a target with a spell, she gains a stack of Essence Theft. When she has enough stacks, her next spell that hits an enemy also heals her.

abilities.name: Orb of Deception
abilities.description: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.

abilities.name: Fox-Fire
abilities.description: Ahri gains a brief burst of movement speed and releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Charm
abilities.description: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her. The target temporarily takes increased damage from Ahri.

abilities.name: Spirit Rush
abilities.description: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown.

abilities.name: ASSASSIN'S MARK
abilities.description: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next autoattack with bonus range and damage.

abilities.name: FIVE POINT STRIKE
abilities.description: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing at maximum range.

abilities.name: TWILIGHT SHROUD
abilities.description: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Movement Speed and restores Energy. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

abilities.name: SHURIKEN FLIP
abilities.description: Akali flips backward and fires a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-casting dashes to the marked target, dealing additional damage.

abilities.name: PERFECT EXECUTION
abilities.description: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-casting dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.

abilities.name: DIRTY FIGHTING
abilities.description: Every third attack or ability hit deals bonus physical damages. Against champions, also gains damage shield for brief moment.

abilities.name: AVENGERANG
abilities.description: Like a typical boomerang spell, can hit each enemy twice (once on way out and in). Boomerang will reach some units beyond the last target hit, if it hits a different target during this it’s range will extend (theoretically range is infinite)

abilities.name: GOING ROGUE
abilities.description: Passive: Enemies that kill Akshan’s allies become Scoundrels for few brief seconds. Killing a Scoundrel grants Akshan bonus golds and reduces the fallen ally’s death timer. Active: Gain camouflage for a few seconds. Duration is refreshed when Akshan is near a wall or in brush. Gains movement speed when moving toward Scoundrels.

abilities.name: HEROIC SWING
abilities.description: Akshan fires a rope that attaches to a wall for a few seconds to allow him to swing in a circle. While swinging, Akshan shoots an enemy he has recently damaged.

abilities.name: COMEUPPANCE
abilities.description: Locks onto an enemy champion and begins overcharging Mist shots over a few seconds.

abilities.name: DRAKEHOUND'S STEP
abilities.description: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

abilities.name: CUNNING SWEEP / SUNDERING SLAM
abilities.description: Ambessa sweeps her twin drakehounds in a semicircle in front of her, dealing bonus damage to enemies hit by the blades. Striking an enemy will transform the next cast of this ability for a short period of time, causing her to slam her twin drakehounds down in a line in front of her, dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: REPUDIATION
abilities.description: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies. If she blocked any non-minion damage while bracing herself, this ability will deal increased damage.

abilities.name: LACERATE
abilities.description: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.

abilities.name: PUBLIC EXECUTION
abilities.description: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

abilities.name: Cursed Touch
abilities.description: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

abilities.name: Bandage Toss
abilities.description: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

abilities.name: Despair
abilities.description: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.

abilities.name: Tantrum
abilities.description: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
abilities.description: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging them and rendering them unable to attack or move.

abilities.name: Pyromania
abilities.description: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.

abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage in a small area and refunding the Mana cost and half its cooldown if it destroys the target.

abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.description: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Molten Shield
abilities.description: Annie casts a shield over herself and Tibbers and gains move speed.

abilities.name: Summon: Tibbers
abilities.description: Annie summons Tibbers, dealing damage in the area. Tibbers enrages after pouncing on an enemy or when Annie dies, gaining move and attack speed. Recast: Annie orders Tibbers to pounce on a target. He deals damage and knocks up the target when he lands.

abilities.name: COSMIC CREATOR
abilities.description: Aurelion Sol's damaging abilities break down enemies into permanent stacks of Stardust, which improve each of his abilities.

abilities.name: BREATH OF LIGHT
abilities.description: Aurelion Sol channels his dragon breath to exhale a beam of starfire, revealing and damaging the first enemy hit and splashing reduced damage onto nearby enemies. Each second the breath is channeled directly at an enemy will deal bonus damage, which is improved by the amount of Stardust that's been collected. This ability collects Stardust if the target is a champion. Aurelion Sol can move while channeling Breath of Light.

abilities.name: ASTRAL FLIGHT
abilities.description: Aurelion Sol flies over terrain in a targeted direction. While in this state, he can cast other abilities. Breath of Light no longer has a cooldown or maximum channel duration and deals increased damage while flying. Astral Flight's remaining cooldown is reduced whenever an enemy champion dies after being recently damaged by Aurelion Sol. Stardust increases Astral Flight's maximum range.

abilities.name: SINGULARITY
abilities.description: Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, damaging enemies and slowly pulling them toward its center. This ability grants Stardust each time an enemy dies within the black hole and for each second an enemy champion is caught inside it. The center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain percentage of their maximum health. Stardust increases Singularity's area as well as the execution threshold.

abilities.name: FALLING STAR / THE SKIES DESCEND
abilities.description:
Falling Star: Aurelion Sol calls down a star. The impact deals magic damage and stuns enemies hit while also granting Stardust for each enemy champion hit. Gathering enough Stardust transforms Aurelion Sol's next ult cast into The Skies Descend.
The Skies Descend: Aurelion Sol calls a giant star down from the heavens with an increased impact zone and increased damage, knocking up enemies rather than stunning them. A shockwave then spreads from the edge of the impact zone, which damages and slows the enemies it hits.

abilities.name: SPIRIT ABJURATION
abilities.description: Aurora's spells and attacks exorcise spirits from the enemies she damages. Exorcised spirits follow Aurora around and heal her.

abilities.name: TWOFOLD HEX
abilities.description: Aurora sends out a missile that curses any enemies it hits. She can then recast the ability to draw active curses back toward herself, damaging foes who are hit along the way.

abilities.name: ACROSS THE VEIL
abilities.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time. Taking down an enemy champion resets this ability's cooldown.

abilities.name: THE WEIRDING
abilities.description: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.

abilities.name: BETWEEN WORLDS
abilities.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

abilities.name: BLAZE
abilities.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 1 seconds, stacking up to 2 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 3 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

abilities.name: SEAR
abilities.description: Launches a projectile that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing damage and applying a stack of Brand’s passive. If the target was previously afflicted by Brand’s passive they are also briefly stunned.

abilities.name: PILLAR OF FLAME
abilities.description: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area.

abilities.name: CONFLAGRATION
abilities.description: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.

abilities.name: PYROCLASM
abilities.description: Launches a projectile that travels to the target, dealing damage and applying a stack of Brand’s passive. The projectile will then bounce to a nearby target. Does not damage Brand.

abilities.name: Adaptive Defenses
abilities.description: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to 20% of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.

abilities.name: Precision Protocol
abilities.description: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus movement speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

abilities.name: Tactical Sweep
abilities.description: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

abilities.name: Hookshot
abilities.description: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

abilities.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
abilities.description: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area, and knocking away other enemies.

abilities.name: HEXTECH MUNITIONS
abilities.description: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is converted into magic damage. Corki can occasionally retrieve The Package inside his base, granting him movement speed and an empowered cast of Valkyrie.

abilities.name: PHOSPHORUS BOMB
abilities.description: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.

abilities.name: VALKYRIE
abilities.description:
Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.

Special Delivery: If Corki has The Package, the flight is longer, enemies are knocked aside and the zone slows and deals damage.

abilities.name: GATLING GUN
abilities.description: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone towards his current target, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.

abilities.name: MISSILE BARRAGE
abilities.description: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every third missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

abilities.name: HEMORRHAGE
abilities.description: Darius's attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over time, stacking up to a cap. Upon reaching full stacks, Darius gains Noxian Might for a few seconds, gaining Attack Damage and applying full stacks of Hemorrhage instead of 1.

abilities.name: DECIMATE
abilities.description: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions hit by the blade, and applies Hemorrhage.

abilities.name: CRIPPLING STRIKE
abilities.description: Darius empowers his next attack to deal additional damage with a large slow.

abilities.name: APPREHEND
abilities.description: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

abilities.name: NOXIAN GUILLOTINE
abilities.description: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed, granting Noxian Might and causing nearby minions and monsters to flee.

abilities.name: MOONSILVER BLADE
abilities.description: Every third strike cleaves nearby enemies for an additional magic damage. After using an ability, Diana gains attack speed for her next 3 attacks.

abilities.name: CRESCENT STRIKE
abilities.description: Unleashes a bolt of lunar energy in an arc dealing magic damage, and applying Moonlight.

abilities.name: PALE CASCADE
abilities.description: Diana creates three orbiting spheres that detonate on contact with enemies to deal damage in an area. She also gains a temporary shield that absorbs damage. If her third sphere detonates, the shield gains additional strength.

abilities.name: LUNAR RUSH
abilities.description: Diana dashes to an enemy and deals magic damage. Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight, removing Moonlight in an area.

abilities.name: MOONFALL
abilities.description: Diana summons the moon in an area, slowing enemies nearby and applying Moonlight in a growing area. Releasing the button slams the moon down, spiraling enemies toward her and dealing damage scaling with the charge time.

abilities.name: GOES WHERE HE PLEASES
abilities.description: Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby. Dr. Mundo can pick it up by walking over it, restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown. Dr. Mundo also has significantly increased Health regeneration.

abilities.name: INFECTED BONESAW
abilities.description: Dr. Mundo throws an infected bonesaw, dealing damage to the first enemy hit based on their current health and slowing them.

abilities.name: HEART ZAPPER
abilities.description: Dr. Mundo electrocutes himself, dealing persistent damage to nearby enemies and storing a portion of damage he takes. At the end of the duration or on Recast, Dr. Mundo deals a burst of damage to nearby enemies. If the burst hit an enemy, he heals a percentage of the stored damage.

abilities.name: BLUNT FORCE TRAUMA
abilities.description: Passive - Dr. Mundo gains bonus Attack Damage, increasing based on his missing Health. Active - Dr. Mundo slams his “medical” bag into an enemy, dealing additional damage based on his missing Health. If the enemy dies they are swatted away, dealing damage to enemies they pass through.

abilities.name: MAXIMUM DOSAGE
abilities.description: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, instantly healing a percent of his missing Health. He then gains bonus Attack Damage and Move Speed, and regenerates a portion of his maximum Health over a long duration.

abilities.name: Z-DRIVE RESONANCE
abilities.description: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.

abilities.name: TIMEWINDER
abilities.description: Ekko throws a temporal grenade that expands into a time-distortion field upon hitting an enemy champion, slowing and damaging anyone caught inside. After a delay, the grenade rewinds back to Ekko, dealing damage on its return.

abilities.name: PARALLEL CONVERGENCE
abilities.description: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to low health enemies. He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.

abilities.name: PHASE DIVE
abilities.description: Ekko rolls evasively while charging up his Z-Drive. His next attack deals bonus damage and warps reality, teleporting him to his target.

abilities.name: CHRONOBREAK
abilities.description: Ekko shatters his timeline, becoming untargetable and rewinding to a more favorable point in time. He returns to whenever he was a few seconds ago, and heals for a percentage of the damage received in that duration. Enemies near his arrival zone take massive damage.

abilities.name: DEMON SHADE
abilities.description: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 5.

abilities.name: HATE SPIKE
abilities.description: Evelynn strikes out with her lasher twice, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can re-cast to shoot another line of spikes at nearby foes.

abilities.name: ALLURE
abilities.description: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to slow or charm her target, based on time cursed, and reduce their magic resist.

abilities.name: WHIPLASH
abilities.description: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains movement speed for a short duration. When exiting Demon Shade, Whiplash pulls Evelynn to her target.

abilities.name: LAST CARESS
abilities.description: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.

abilities.name: A HARMLESS SCARECROW
abilities.description: When participating in a takedown Fiddlesticks leaves behind a movable scarecrow. The scarecrow will move toward the nearest enemy champion and explode when killed or after several seconds, causing fear.

abilities.name: TERRIFY
abilities.description:
Passive: When Fiddlesticks is out of combat for a longer time period and is invisible to enemy units, or has been stationary for a short period, its next skill will fear the target.

Fiddlesticks launches a raven at a target, dealing magic damage and fear. The raven deals bonus damage if the unit has been terrified recently.

abilities.name: BOUNTIFUL HARVEST
abilities.description: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration. During channeling, Fiddlestick is slowed and cannot cast any other abilities.

abilities.name: REAP
abilities.description: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.

abilities.name: CROWSTORM
abilities.description: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.

abilities.name: SEASTONE TRIDENT
abilities.description: Fizz's attacks deal additional damage over time.

abilities.name: Urchin Strike
abilities.description: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.

abilities.name: RENDING WAVE
abilities.description: Empowers Fizz' next attack to deal bonus damage, and killing a unit resets Rending Wave's cooldown. Additional attacks deal more damage.

abilities.name: Playful / Trickster
abilities.description: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

abilities.name: Chum the Waters
abilities.description: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

abilities.name: COLOSSAL SMASH
abilities.description: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area. Galio gains attack speed when Colossal Smash is up. When an ability hits an epic monster or enemy champion, it reduces the cooldown of Colossal Smash by 3 seconds. This effect can only be triggered once per cast.

abilities.name: WINDS OF WAR
abilities.description: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time.

abilities.name: SHIELD OF DURAND
abilities.description: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemy champions.

abilities.name: JUSTICE PUNCH
abilities.description: Galio will briefly step back and charge, damaging and knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters.

abilities.name: HERO'S ENTRANCE
abilities.description: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Happy Hour
abilities.description: Gragas periodically heals upon using an ability.

abilities.name: Barrel Roll
abilities.description: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 3 seconds. Enemies struck by the blast have their Movement Speed slowed.

abilities.name: Drunken Rage
abilities.description: Gragas guzzles down brew from his cask for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes drunkenly empowered, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.

abilities.name: Body Slam
abilities.description: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.

abilities.name: Explosive Cask
abilities.description: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.

abilities.name: New Destiny
abilities.description: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.

abilities.name: End of the Line
abilities.description: Graves fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1.5 seconds, or 0.25 seconds if it strikes terrain.

abilities.name: Smoke Screen
abilities.description: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their movement speed reduced briefly.

abilities.name: Quickdraw
abilities.description: Graves dashes forward gaining an Armor boost for several seconds. If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead. Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.

abilities.name: Collateral Damage
abilities.description: Graves fires an explosive shell dealing heavy damage to the first champion it hits, and pushing Graves back from recoil. After hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, the shell explodes dealing damage in a cone.

abilities.name: THOUSAND CUTS
abilities.description: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the target's health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

abilities.name: SNIP SNIP!
abilities.description: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

abilities.name: HALLOWED MIST
abilities.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

abilities.name: SKIP 'N SLASH
abilities.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage on-hit for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

abilities.name: NEEDLEWORK
abilities.description: Gwen hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts to champions hit. This ability can be cast up to two more times, with each cast throwing additional needles and dealing more damage.

abilities.name: WARPATH
abilities.description: Hecarim gains Attack Damage equal to a percentage of his bonus Move Speed.

abilities.name: RAMPAGE
abilities.description: Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies dealing physical damage. If Hecarim damages at least one enemy, he increases the damage and lowers the cooldown of subsequent Rampages.

abilities.name: SPIRIT OF DREAD
abilities.description: Hecarim gains Armor and Magic Resist. Hecarim deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and gains Health equal to a percentage of any damage those enemies suffer.

abilities.name: DEVASTATING CHARGE
abilities.description: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed and can move through units for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.

abilities.name: ONSLAUGHT OF SHADOWS
abilities.description: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge, causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.

abilities.name: HEXTECH AFFINITY
abilities.description: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.

abilities.name: H-28 G EVOLUTION TURRET
abilities.description: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

abilities.name: HEXTECH MICRO-ROCKETS
abilities.description: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.

abilities.name: CH-2 ELECTRON STORM GRENADE
abilities.description: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.

abilities.name: UPGRADE!!!
abilities.description: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.

abilities.name: SIGNATURE OF THE VISIONARY
abilities.description: Hwei damages enemy champions, priming them for his signature finisher. The second hit completes his signature, which detonates after a delay, dealing magic damage to enemies in range.

abilities.name: SUBJECT: DISASTER
abilities.description:
Hwei replaces his abilities with damaging powers:

Devastating Fire – fires a flaming projectile.
Severing Bolt – casts a long range lightning strike.
Molten Fissure – shoot a fiery path that keeps erupting.

abilities.name: SUBJECT: SERENITY
abilities.description:
Hwei replaces abilities with utility buffs:

Fleeting Current – increases move speed.
Pool of Reflection – creates water shields.
Stirring Lights – restores mana and inflicts bonus damage.

abilities.name: SUBJECT: TORMENT
abilities.description:
Hwei replaces abilities with crowd control powers:

Grim Visage – fears and slows.
Gaze of the Abyss – sends homing missile eye with True Sight.
Crushing Maw – draws in foes to damage and slow.

abilities.name: SPIRALING DESPAIR
abilities.description: Hwei captures enemy champions in an expanding field that slows and damages, exploding upon reaching maximum size, or the champion’s demise.

abilities.name: IONIAN FERVOR
abilities.description: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

abilities.name: BLADESURGE
abilities.description: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.

abilities.name: DEFIANT DANCE
abilities.description: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.

abilities.name: FLAWLESS DUET
abilities.description: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.

abilities.name: VANGUARD'S EDGE
abilities.description: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.

abilities.name: Martial Cadence
abilities.description: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Dragon Strike
abilities.description: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.

abilities.name: Golden Aegis
abilities.description: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Demacian Standard
abilities.description: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions. Cast again to automatically cast Dragon Strike to the flag.

abilities.name: Cataclysm
abilities.description: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them. Nearby enemies are damaged at the moment of impact.

abilities.name: Relentless Assault
abilities.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Leap Strike
abilities.description: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

abilities.name: Empower
abilities.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

abilities.name: Counter Strike
abilities.description: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: Grandmaster's Might
abilities.description: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

abilities.name: HEXTECH CAPACITOR
abilities.description: When Jayce swaps weapons he gains movement speed for a short duration.

abilities.name: TO THE SKIES! / SHOCK BLAST
abilities.description: Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies. Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit.

abilities.name: LIGHTNING FIELD / HYPER CHARGE
abilities.description: Hammer Stance: Passive: Restores Mana per strike. Active: Creates a field of lightning damaging nearby enemies for several seconds. Cannon Stance: Gains a burst of energy, increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.

abilities.name: THUNDERING BLOW / ACCELERATION GATE
abilities.description: Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance. Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Movement Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.

abilities.name: MERCURY CANNON / MERCURY HAMMER
abilities.description: Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist. Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.

abilities.name: MANTRA
abilities.description: After using 3 abilities, Karma's next ability will be enhanced.

abilities.name: INNER FLAME
abilities.description: Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit. Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

abilities.name: FOCUSED RESOLVE
abilities.description: Karma creates a tether between herself and up to two targeted enemies dealing damage and revealing them. If the tethers are not broken, the enemies will be rooted and damaged again. Mantra Bonus: Karma creates an additional tether between the targets, dealing extra damage and extending the root duration. If only a single enemy is within range, a tether will spread from them to the next nearest enemy.

abilities.name: INSPIRE
abilities.description: Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally. Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

abilities.name: TRANSCENDENT EMBRACE
abilities.description: Karma forms a ring of spirit energy at a target location. After a brief delay, it detonates, dealing magic damage to all enemies inside and slowing them for a few seconds. If enemies are hit at the edge of the ring, they will be pulled in toward the center. Karma immediately enters the Mantra state.

abilities.name: VOID STONE
abilities.description: When Kassadin casts a spell near a visible enemy champion, he gains a magic shield.

abilities.name: NULL SPHERE
abilities.description: Fires an orb that deals magic damage and silences the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: NETHER BLADE
abilities.description:
Empowers his next basic attack within to gain range and deal bonus magic damage and restore a percentage of missing mana on hit.

If Nether Blade kills the target its remaining cooldown is reduced.

abilities.name: FORCE PULSE
abilities.description:
Deals magic damage to enemies in a cone and slows them.

Force Pulse becomes enhanced after other spells are cast nearby, dealing increased magic damage and slowing instead.

abilities.name: RIFTWALK
abilities.description: Blinks to target location and deals magic damage to nearby enemies. Casting Riftwalk causes the next Riftwalk within a certain amount of time to deal more damage and cost double the mana. (Up to 3 times)

abilities.name: VORACITY
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced. If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: BOUNCING BLADE
abilities.description: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.

abilities.name: PREPARATION
abilities.description: Katarina gains a burst of movement speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.

abilities.name: SHUNPO
abilities.description: Katarina blinks to a location near a Dagger or unit, dealing damage to the nearest enemy. Picking up a Dagger reduces Shunpo's cooldown.

abilities.name: DEATH LOTUS
abilities.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing damage over time and applying healing reduction. Katarina is able to slowly reposition for a short time.

abilities.name: DIVINE ASCENT
abilities.description: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Movement Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

abilities.name: RADIANT BLAST
abilities.description: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.

abilities.name: CELESTIAL BLESSING
abilities.description: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants movement speed to herself and the nearest ally.

abilities.name: STARFIRE SPELLBLADE
abilities.description: Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks. Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.

abilities.name: DIVINE JUDGMENT
abilities.description: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.

abilities.name: THE DARKIN SCYTHE
abilities.description: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin. Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions. Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

abilities.name: REAPING SLASH
abilities.description: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.

abilities.name: BLADE'S REACH
abilities.description: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.

abilities.name: SHADOW STEP
abilities.description: Kayn can walk through terrain.

abilities.name: UMBRAL TRESPASS
abilities.description: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.

abilities.name: MARK OF THE STORM
abilities.description: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

abilities.name: THUNDERING SHURIKEN
abilities.description: Throws a shuriken, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: ELECTRICAL SURGE
abilities.description: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.

abilities.name: LIGHTNING RUSH
abilities.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, becoming unable to attack. Kennen gains movement speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.

abilities.name: SLICING MAELSTROM
abilities.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

abilities.name: UNSEEN THREAT
abilities.description: When the enemy team loses sight of Kha'Zix its next attack against enemy champions deals bonus magic damage and slows them briefly.

abilities.name: TASTE THEIR FEAR
abilities.description: Kha'Zix causes physical damage by slashes with its claws dealing additional damage if the target is isolated. Evolved Reaper Claws: basic attacks and Taste Their Fear have increased range and if a target is isolated, meaning that they have no teammates or turrets nearby, then a significant portion of Taste Their Fear's cooldown is refunded.

abilities.name: VOID SPIKE
abilities.description: Kha'Zix fires spikes to deal physical damage while also partially healing itself if it is within the explosion. Evolved Spike Racks: fires additional spikes revealing and slowing enemies for a short duration.

abilities.name: LEAP
abilities.description: Kha'Zix leaps to a targeted area and deals physical damage. Evolved Wings: Leap gains significant range and the cooldown is refunded on champion takedowns.

abilities.name: VOID ASSAULT
abilities.description: Passive: each upgrade to Void Assault allows for Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities. Active: Kha'Zix becomes invisible and gains movement speed briefly. Evolved Adaptive Cloaking: invisibility duration lasts longer and can be cast multiple times.

abilities.name: MARK OF THE KINDRED
abilities.description: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

abilities.name: DANCE OF ARROWS
abilities.description: Kindred tumbles and shoots up to three arrows at nearby targets.

abilities.name: WOLF'S FRENZY
abilities.description: Wolf enrages and attacks enemies around him. Lamb passively gains stacks by moving and attacking. When fully charged, Lamb's next attack restores health.

abilities.name: MOUNTING DREAD
abilities.description: Lamb fires a carefully placed shot, slowing the target. If Lamb attacks the target two more times, her third attack instead directs Wolf to pounce on the enemy, savaging them for massive damage.

abilities.name: LAMB'S RESPITE
abilities.description: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

abilities.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
abilities.description: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds. Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

abilities.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
abilities.description: Lee Sin rushes to target position, shielding himself from damage if an enemy champion or monster is near the landing point. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will for the next few seconds. Iron Will: Lee Sin's next attack deals bonus magic damage and has omnivamp.

abilities.name: Tempest / Cripple
abilities.description: Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple for the next 3 seconds. Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Movement Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

abilities.name: Dragon's Rage
abilities.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration.

abilities.name: DREAM-LADEN BOUGH
abilities.description: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

abilities.name: BLOOMING BLOWS
abilities.description: Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells. She can activate this to deal magic damage to nearby enemies, dealing extra true damage on the edge.

abilities.name: WATCH OUT! EEP!
abilities.description: Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center.

abilities.name: SWIRLSEED
abilities.description: Lillia hurls a seed that damages and slows those it lands on. If it doesn't hit anything, it will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target.

abilities.name: LILTING LULLABY
abilities.description: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.

abilities.name: ICEBORN SUBJUGATION
abilities.description: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

abilities.name: ICE SHARD
abilities.description: Throws a spear of ice that shatters when it hits an enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing Move Speed. Shards pass through the target, dealing the same damage to other enemies hit.

abilities.name: RING OF FROST
abilities.description: Freezes nearby enemies in ice, dealing magic damage and rooting them.

abilities.name: GLACIAL PATH
abilities.description: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.

abilities.name: FROZEN TOMB
abilities.description: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.

abilities.name: LIGHTSLINGER
abilities.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot.

abilities.name: PIERCING LIGHT
abilities.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.

abilities.name: ARDENT BLAZE
abilities.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking and briefly revealing enemies. Lucian gains Movement Speed for attacking marked enemies.

abilities.name: RELENTLESS PURSUIT
abilities.description: Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.

abilities.name: THE CULLING
abilities.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

abilities.name: Illumination
abilities.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for 5 seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

abilities.name: Light Binding
abilities.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

abilities.name: Prismatic Barrier
abilities.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

abilities.name: Lucent Singularity
abilities.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

abilities.name: Final Spark
abilities.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

abilities.name: Granite Shield
abilities.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for 8 seconds, this effect recharges.

abilities.name: Seismic Shard
abilities.description: Using his primal elemental magic, Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Malphite passively gains armor. When Malphite activates Thunderclap, he attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor as damage and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Force
abilities.description: Malphite ferociously charges to a location, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

abilities.name: SAP MAGIC
abilities.description: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

abilities.name: BRAMBLE SMASH
abilities.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

abilities.name: TWISTED ADVANCE
abilities.description: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

abilities.name: SAPLING TOSS
abilities.description: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

abilities.name: NATURE'S GRASP
abilities.description: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

abilities.name: Double Strike
abilities.description: Every few consecutive basic attacks, Master Yi strikes twice.

abilities.name: Alpha Strike
abilities.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

abilities.name: Meditate
abilities.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time.

abilities.name: Wuju Style
abilities.description: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.

abilities.name: Highlander
abilities.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Movement and Attack Speeds as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

abilities.name: SEARING BRILLIANCE
abilities.description: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack. When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

abilities.name: RADIANT VOLLEY
abilities.description: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area.

abilities.name: REBUTTAL
abilities.description: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

abilities.name: SOLAR SNARE
abilities.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies within range, while rooting those at its center.

abilities.name: GOLDEN ECLIPSE
abilities.description: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm. Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

abilities.name: DARKNESS RISE
abilities.description: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

abilities.name: OBLITERATE
abilities.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

abilities.name: INDESTRUCTIBLE
abilities.description: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

abilities.name: DEATH'S GRASP
abilities.description: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

abilities.name: REALM OF DEATH
abilities.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

abilities.name: SOUL SIPHON
abilities.description: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

abilities.name: DARK BINDING
abilities.description: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: TORMENTED SHADOW
abilities.description: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.

abilities.name: BLACK SHIELD
abilities.description: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.

abilities.name: SOUL SHACKLES
abilities.description: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed towards them. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.

abilities.name: STAGGERING BLOW
abilities.description: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.

abilities.name: DREDGE LINE
abilities.description: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage. Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.

abilities.name: TITAN'S WRATH
abilities.description: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield. While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.

abilities.name: RIPTIDE
abilities.description: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.

abilities.name: DEPTH CHARGE
abilities.description: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.

abilities.name: PROWL
abilities.description: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed, increasing when moving towards an enemy. Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting brief True Sight of them. During this time, Nidalee gains Move Speed (increased when moving towards the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

abilities.name: JAVELIN TOSS / TAKEDOWN
abilities.description:
In human form, Nidalee throws a javelin at her target dealing Magic Damage, that gains damage as it flies.
In cougar form, her next attack will wound her target, dealing more damage the lower their health is.

abilities.name: BUSHWHACK / POUNCE
abilities.description:
In human form, Nidalee lays a stealthed trap, dealing Magic Damage and revealing its target when sprung.
In cougar form, she leaps in a target location, dealing Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: PRIMAL SURGE / SWIPE
abilities.description:
In human form, Nidalee heals the target and imbues Attack Speed for a short duration.
In cougar form, she claws in a target direction, dealing Magic Damage to enemies hit.

abilities.name: ASPECT OF THE COUGAR
abilities.description:
Passive: While in Human Form, marking enemies as hunted will reset Aspect of the Cougar’s cooldown.
Active: Nidalee transforms between cougar and human, gaining new abilities.

abilities.name: UMBRA BLADES
abilities.description: Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself. Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

abilities.name: DUSKBRINGER
abilities.description: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

abilities.name: SHROUD OF DARKNESS
abilities.description: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

abilities.name: UNSPEAKABLE HORROR
abilities.description: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

abilities.name: PARANOIA
abilities.description: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

abilities.name: BELOVED TRINKETS
abilities.description: Norra’s next ability leaves Trinkets on the battlefield. When an enemy touches a Trinket, it activates and fires a projectile at the triggering enemy. When Norra’s abilities hit enemy champions, the ability’s cooldown is reduced.

abilities.name: MEMORY SURGE
abilities.description:
Norra charges and fires a bolt of magical energy in target direction. She’s slowed while charging. The energy bolt stops upon hitting the first enemy champion, dealing magic damage to the target and nearby enemies. Enemies marked with Thread Sigils take bonus magic damage.
At full charge, all Trinkets within the area are activated and the hit target is treated as Trinket-activated.

abilities.name: JOURNEY TO NOWHERE
abilities.description: Norra reveals a mystical portal in a target circular area, dealing magic damage to all enemy champions within the area and banishing them to an alternate realm. Banished enemies are untargetable, slowed, and can’t cast.

abilities.name: THREADS OF HOMECOMING
abilities.description:
Passive: Damage dealing Trinkets apply a Thread Sigil to their targets.
Norra summons portals on both sides of a target area. The portals fire magical threads between each other, dealing magic damage to all enemies in the area and applying Thread Sigils. Thread Sigils slow their targets and increase their collision size.

abilities.name: PORTALPALOOZA!
abilities.description: Norra conjures a huge portal enveloping all units within the area. Magical projectiles will fire four times, dealing magic damage to all enemies along their path. The projectile direction is determined by swiping. The last projectile deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: CALL OF THE FRELJORD
abilities.description: Nunu increases the attack speed and movement speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.

abilities.name: CONSUME
abilities.description: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

abilities.name: BIGGEST SNOWBALL EVER!
abilities.description: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it. The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

abilities.name: SNOWBALL BARRAGE
abilities.description: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies. When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.

abilities.name: ABSOLUTE ZERO
abilities.description: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

abilities.name: Berserker Rage
abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased by 1% for each 1% of his Health he is missing.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and slowing their Movement Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reduced by 4.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Vicious Strikes
abilities.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased, he gains Physical Vamp and has increased healing from all sources based on how much Health he is missing.

abilities.name: Reckless Swing
abilities.description: Olaf dashes to an enemy and attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target. If the target does not die, Olaf takes true damage.

abilities.name: Ragnarok
abilities.description: Olaf temporarily becomes immune to disables.

abilities.name: Clockwork Windup
abilities.description: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

abilities.name: Command: Attack
abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.

abilities.name: Command: Dissonance
abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

abilities.name: Command: Protect
abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.

abilities.name: Command: Shockwave
abilities.description: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

abilities.name: MORTAL WILL
abilities.description: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

abilities.name: COMET SPEAR
abilities.description: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction. Low health enemies are critically hit. Mortal Will: Deals additional damage.

abilities.name: SHIELD VAULT
abilities.description: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them. Mortal Will: Follows up with an additional attack that strikes 3 times.

abilities.name: AEGIS ASSAULT
abilities.description: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear. Mortal Will: Pantheon gains movement speed.

abilities.name: GRAND STARFALL
abilities.description: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet, slowing and dealing damage in a line pointing to where he lands.

abilities.name: IRON AMBASSADOR
abilities.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

abilities.name: HAMMER SHOCK
abilities.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

abilities.name: STEADFAST PRESENCE
abilities.description: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

abilities.name: HEROIC CHARGE
abilities.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

abilities.name: KEEPER'S VERDICT
abilities.description: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

abilities.name: ROLLING ARMORDILLO
abilities.description: Rammus starts rolling while out of combat, gaining movement speed. Entering battle will temporarily disable this effect.

abilities.name: POWERBALL
abilities.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

abilities.name: DEFENSIVE BALL CURL
abilities.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, amplifying Spiked Shells' damage, and returning damage to enemies that basic attack him, but he is also slowed during this time.

abilities.name: FRENZYING TAUNT
abilities.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him. Additionally, he gains increased Attack Speed for a short time.

abilities.name: SOARING SLAM
abilities.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down, dealing damage and creating aftershocks. Aftershocks slow enemies. The hopping distance increases based upon Powerball's current speed.

abilities.name: UNSEEN PREDATOR
abilities.description: Rengar leaps to his target when attacking if he is in the brush. Unique enemy champion takedowns grant him bonus Attack Damage. Casting basic abilities grants Rengar Ferocity which empowers his basic abilities. Casting empowered abilities briefly grants him bonus Movement Speed.

abilities.name: SAVAGERY
abilities.description: Rengar's next couple of attacks gain Attack Speed. The first attack deals additional physical damage and Critically Strikes, with Critical Strike Chance further increasing the damage. Ferocity: Rengar gains even more Attack Speed and the first attack deals even more physical damage.

abilities.name: BATTLE ROAR
abilities.description: Rengar damages nearby enemies and heals himself for some of the recent damage he has taken. Ferocity: Rengar deals more damage and removes all crowd control effects from himself.

abilities.name: BOLA STRIKE
abilities.description: Rengar throws a bola, dealing physical damage and slowing the target struck. The bola also reveals the target and grants vision of the surrounding area. Ferocity: Rengar deals more damage and roots the target.

abilities.name: THRILL OF THE HUNT
abilities.description: Rengar gains movement speed and reveals the nearest enemy champion for a period of time. Shortly after casting Rengar becomes camoflauged with his next attack shredding the target's armor for a period of time.

abilities.name: RUNIC BLADE
abilities.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

abilities.name: BROKEN WINGS
abilities.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

abilities.name: KI BURST
abilities.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

abilities.name: VALOR
abilities.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

abilities.name: BLADE OF THE EXILE
abilities.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once. Taking down a target with her will extend the ability time and grant a re-cast of Wind Slash.

abilities.name: ARCANE MASTERY
abilities.description: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.

abilities.name: OVERLOAD
abilities.description: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed. On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

abilities.name: RUNE PRISON
abilities.description: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

abilities.name: SPELL FLUX
abilities.description: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.

abilities.name: REALM WARP
abilities.description: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux. On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

abilities.name: STAGE PRESENCE
abilities.description: Every third ability cast will Echo, casting it again. Casting Seraphine's abilities grants a Note to nearby allies. For each Note, Seraphine's next basic attack gains Attack Range and bonus damage.

abilities.name: HIGH NOTE
abilities.description: Seraphine deals damage in an area, increased by enemies' missing Health.

abilities.name: SURROUND SOUND
abilities.description: Seraphine shields all nearly ally champions and grants them Movement Speed. If Seraphine is already shielded, nearby allies are healed, increasing for each ally.

abilities.name: BEAT DROP
abilities.description: Seraphine deals damage and slows enemies. If the enemy is already slowed, they are rooted instead. If they are already rooted, they are stunned instead.

abilities.name: ENCORE
abilities.description: Seraphine deals damage in a line, charming and slowing enemies. Encore extends if it touches an ally or enemy champion.

abilities.name: KI BARRIER
abilities.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

abilities.name: TWILIGHT ASSAULT
abilities.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

abilities.name: SPIRIT'S REFUGE
abilities.description: Shen sends his spirit blade to an ally, creating a zone that blocks enemy attacks.

abilities.name: SHADOW DASH
abilities.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path

abilities.name: STAND UNITED
abilities.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

abilities.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
abilities.description: Shyvana gains stacks when slaying large and epic monsters, as well as champions. Dragons grant extra stacks. Every 100 stack enhances one of Shyvana's abilities.

abilities.name: Twin Bite
abilities.description: Shyvana strikes twice on her next attack. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of Twin Bite. Dragon Form: Twin Bite cleaves all units in front of Shyvana. Slaying Mountain Drake causes Twin Bite to slow enemies while in Dragon Form.

abilities.name: Burnout
abilities.description: Shyvana surrounds herself in fire, dealing magic damage per second to nearby enemies and moving faster for 3 seconds. The Movement Speed reduces over the duration of the spell. Basic attacks extend the duration of Burnout. Dragon Form: Burnout grows in size. Slaying Cloud Drake gives Shyvana 25% extra Movement Speed while in Dragon Form.

abilities.name: Flame Breath
abilities.description: Shyvana unleashes a fireball that deals damage to all enemies it encounters and leaves cinders on the target, marking them for 5 seconds. Shyvana's basic attacks on marked targets deal a percentage of their maximum Health as damage on-hit. Dragon Form: Flame Breath explodes on impact or at target location, dealing bonus damage and scorching the earth for a short duration. Slaying Infernal Drake converts damage dealt to marked enemies to true damage while in Dragon Form.

abilities.name: Dragon's Descent
abilities.description: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight to a target location. Enemies along her path take damage and are knocked toward her target location. Shyvana passively gains Fury per second and gains 2 Fury on basic attack.

abilities.name: GLORY IN DEATH
abilities.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

abilities.name: DECIMATING SMASH
abilities.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

abilities.name: SOUL FURNACE
abilities.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

abilities.name: ROAR OF THE SLAYER
abilities.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE ONSLAUGHT
abilities.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

abilities.name: THREADS OF VIBRATION
abilities.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

abilities.name: SHATTERED EARTH/UPHEAVAL
abilities.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

abilities.name: SEISMIC BASTION
abilities.description: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

abilities.name: IXTAL'S IMPACT
abilities.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

abilities.name: IMPALE
abilities.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to damage and suppress enemy champions. Suppressed victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around. If Skarner hits at least one champion, he gains Move Speed. If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will first cast Upheaval.

abilities.name: Ravenous Flock
abilities.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health and scaling with Ability Power.

abilities.name: Death's Hand
abilities.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

abilities.name: Vision of Empire
abilities.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

abilities.name: Nevermove
abilities.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer.

abilities.name: Demonic Ascension
abilities.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate multiple times and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

abilities.name: PETRICITE BURST
abilities.description: After using an ability, Sylas stores a charge, stacking up to three. Sylas’ basic attacks expend a charge, whirling his chains and dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. If Sylas has at least one charge, he gains attack speed.

abilities.name: CHAIN LASH
abilities.description: Sylas lashes out with his chains, dealing damage and slowing enemies. After a delay, energy explodes from the chains’ intersection point, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: KINGSLAYER
abilities.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force, dealing magic damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

abilities.name: ABSCOND/ABDUCT
abilities.description: Sylas dashes to a location and prepares a recast. He can recast the ability, throwing his chains out, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, and dealing damage.

abilities.name: HIJACK
abilities.description: Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, stealing their ultimate ability to use freely.

abilities.name: TRANSCENDENT
abilities.description: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath by dealing ability damage to enemies and every time she levels up an ability. Splinters of Wrath can be used to upgrade her abilities and increase ability power.

abilities.name: DARK SPHERE
abilities.description: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere that deals magic damage where it appears. The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers. Upgrade: Syndra gains an additional charge of Dark Sphere.

abilities.name: FORCE OF WILL
abilities.description: Syndra hurls the nearest Dark Sphere at a target location, dealing magic damage and slowing the Move Speed of enemies within the area. Upgrade: Syndra deals bonus true damage.

abilities.name: SCATTER THE WEAK
abilities.description: Syndra sends out a wave of force, dealing magic damage and knocking back enemies and Dark Spheres. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres are stunned and take additional damage. Upgrade: Syndra increases the range of the wave of force.

abilities.name: UNLEASHED POWER
abilities.description: Syndra launches the Dark Spheres orbiting her and any nearby at an enemy champion, dealing magic damage for each Sphere. Upgrade: The Dark Spheres execute enemies with low Health. When killing an enemy, the Spheres will explode on the spot and deal damage to nearby enemy champions.

abilities.name: ROCK SURFING
abilities.description: When not in combat, Taliyah gains Move Speed near walls.

abilities.name: THREADED VOLLEY
abilities.description:
Taliyah throws a volley of rocks in a target direction, each rock dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit and creating a quarry in the area around them.
If Taliyah casts Threaded Volley in a quarry, she consumes the ground to throw a stronger boulder that damages and slows enemies.

abilities.name: SEISMIC SHOVE
abilities.description: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

abilities.name: UNRAVELED EARTH
abilities.description: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode, damaging and slowing them.

abilities.name: WEAVER'S WALL
abilities.description:
Taliyah summons a massive wall. If she immediately casts it again, she steps on and surfs along it.
