The wall knocks back enemies. Once it’s fully formed, Taliyah can cast again to destroy it early.

abilities.name: BLADE'S END
abilities.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

abilities.name: NOXIAN DIPLOMACY
abilities.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

abilities.name: RAKE
abilities.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

abilities.name: ASSASSIN'S PATH
abilities.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

abilities.name: SHADOW ASSAULT
abilities.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

abilities.name: TOXIC SHOT
abilities.description: Teemo's attacks deal bonus magic damage over time.

abilities.name: BLINDING DART
abilities.description: Teemo fires a dart that blinds its target, causing its attacks to deal no damage for a brief period.

abilities.name: MOVE QUICK
abilities.description: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Movement Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Activating Move Quick causes Teemo to roll forward a short distance, sprinting for a few seconds. During this time, Move Quick's passive speed is doubled, and cannot be removed by damage.

abilities.name: GUERILLA WARFARE
abilities.description: After a delay, Teemo becomes camouflaged, unable to be seen unless near an enemy champion or turret. After exiting camouflage, Teemo gains Attack Speed.

abilities.name: NOXIOUS TRAP
abilities.description: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous puddle, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

abilities.name: Battle Fury
abilities.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

abilities.name: Mocking Shout
abilities.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Movement Speed reduced.

abilities.name: Spinning Slash
abilities.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

abilities.name: Undying Rage
abilities.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

abilities.name: Loaded Dice
abilities.description: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving bonus gold.

abilities.name: Wild Cards
abilities.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

abilities.name: Pick a Card
abilities.description: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects. Red Cards deal damage in an area and slow, Blue Cards deal damage and restore mana, and Gold Cards deal damage and stun.

abilities.name: Stacked Deck
abilities.description: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. Activating this skill increases his Attack Speed, and attacking enemy champions rolls his Loaded Dice.

abilities.name: Destiny
abilities.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: DEADLY VENOM
abilities.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target, dealing true damage each second.

abilities.name: AMBUSH
abilities.description: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration. When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

abilities.name: VENOM CASK
abilities.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

abilities.name: CONTAMINATE
abilities.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

abilities.name: SPRAY AND PRAY
abilities.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

abilities.name: PHENOMENAL EVIL POWER
abilities.description: Veigar now gains passive stacks by hitting enemy champions once again.

abilities.name: BALEFUL STRIKE
abilities.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

abilities.name: DARK MATTER
abilities.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

abilities.name: EVENT HORIZON
abilities.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

abilities.name: PRIMORDIAL BURST
abilities.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

abilities.name: ORGANIC DECONSTRUCTION
abilities.description: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

abilities.name: PLASMA FISSION
abilities.description: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit.

abilities.name: VOID RIFT
abilities.description: Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void that deals an initial burst of damage, then explodes for a second burst of damage after a delay.

abilities.name: TECTONIC DISRUPTION
abilities.description: Vel'Koz causes an explosive anomaly at target location, knocking up enemies and knocking close enemies slightly away. The closer the anomaly is to Vel’Koz the stronger the knockback effect.

abilities.name: LIFE FORM DISINTEGRATION RAY
abilities.description:
Passive: Apply 3 Deconstruction stacks to an enemy champion marking them as Researched for 7 seconds.
Active: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that he can steer in a target direction to deal magic damage and slow enemies hit. Researched enemy champions take true damage instead.

abilities.name: DOOM 'N GLOOM
abilities.description: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

abilities.name: MISTRAL BOLT
abilities.description: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

abilities.name: PERSONAL SPACE
abilities.description: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

abilities.name: LOOMING DARKNESS
abilities.description: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

abilities.name: SHADOW SURGE
abilities.description: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

abilities.name: DENTING BLOWS
abilities.description: Every third attack on the same enemy deals a percentage of their maximum Health, reduces their Armor, and grants Vi Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Vault Breaker
abilities.description: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.

abilities.name: BLAST SHIELD
abilities.description: Vi gains stacks of Blast Shield when hitting an enemy with an attack or ability. Activating Blast Shield generates a shield that absorbs damage. At maximum stacks, Vi also gains Movement Speed.

abilities.name: Relentless Force
abilities.description: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.

abilities.name: Cease and Desist
abilities.description: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.

abilities.name: SOVEREIGN'S DOMINATION
abilities.description: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

abilities.name: BLADE OF THE RUINED KING
abilities.description: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health. Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.

abilities.name: SPECTRAL MAW
abilities.description: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: HARROWED PATH
abilities.description: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.

abilities.name: HEARTBREAKER
abilities.description: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.

abilities.name: GLORIOUS EVOLUTION
abilities.description: Viktor can augment his basic abilities when he gets kills on enemies.

abilities.name: SIPHON POWER
abilities.description: Viktor blasts an enemy unit dealing magic damage, gaining a shield and empowering his next basic attack. Augment: Siphon Power's shield is increased by 60% and Viktor gains bonus Move Speed after casting.

abilities.name: GRAVITY FIELD
abilities.description: Viktor conjures a heavy gravitational field that slows enemies in its radius. Enemies who stay within the device for too long are stunned. Augment: Viktor's non-periodic spells apply a slow to enemies.

abilities.name: HEXTECH RAY
abilities.description: Viktor uses his robotic arm to fire a chaos beam that cuts across the field in a line, dealing damage to all enemies in its path. Augment: An explosion follows the Death Ray's wake, dealing magic damage.

abilities.name: ARCANE STORM
abilities.description: Viktor conjures a singularity on the field which deals magic damage and interrupts enemy channels. The singularity then periodically does magic damage to all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: CRIMSON PACT
abilities.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

abilities.name: TRANSFUSION
abilities.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

abilities.name: SANGUINE POOL
abilities.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

abilities.name: TIDES OF BLOOD
abilities.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

abilities.name: HEMOPLAGUE
abilities.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

abilities.name: THE RELENTLESS STORM
abilities.description: Volibear's Attacks and abilities grant Attack Speed, and eventually cause his Attacks to deal bonus magic damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: THUNDERING SMASH
abilities.description: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

abilities.name: FRENZIED MAUL
abilities.description: Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and gaining a mark. Casting this ability again on the same target consumes the mark to deal bonus damage and heal Volibear.

abilities.name: SKY SPLITTER
abilities.description: Volibear summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a shield if he's inside the blast radius.

abilities.name: STORMBRINGER
abilities.description: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

abilities.name: ETERNAL HUNGER
abilities.description: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals for the same amount.

abilities.name: JAWS OF THE BEAST
abilities.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

abilities.name: BLOODHUNT
abilities.description: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and Attack Speed against them. When they fall below 20% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.

abilities.name: PRIMAL HOWL
abilities.description: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

abilities.name: INFINITE DURESS
abilities.description: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

abilities.name: CRUSHING BLOWS
abilities.description: Wukong and his clones' attacks and abilities apply stacks of Crushing Blows. For each stack, Wukong and his clones deal increased damage to the target.

abilities.name: GOLDEN STAFF
abilities.description: Passively gives Wukong's next attack bonus range after casting an ability. Wukong's next attack deals additional damage and heals him.

abilities.name: WARRIOR TRICKSTER
abilities.description: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack enemies for reduced damage, mimicking Golden Staff and Cyclone.

abilities.name: NIMBUS STRIKE
abilities.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck, and grants Wukong a temporary Attack Speed increase.

abilities.name: CYCLONE
abilities.description: Wukong extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Movement Speed. Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up. Cyclone can be recast within a short time window.

abilities.name: Determination
abilities.description: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

abilities.name: Three Talon Strike
abilities.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

abilities.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
abilities.description: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies.

abilities.name: Audacious Charge
abilities.description: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, dealing damage to all enemies in the area and slowing them briefly.

abilities.name: Crescent Guard
abilities.description: Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back. Xin Zhao is impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.

abilities.name: Way of the Wanderer
abilities.description: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is doubled. Additionally, Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion or monster.

abilities.name: Steel Tempest
abilities.description: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line. On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne. Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things.

abilities.name: Wind Wall
abilities.description: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Sweeping Blade
abilities.description: Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases your next dash's base Damage, up to a max amount. Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds. If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.

abilities.name: Last Breath
abilities.description: Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm. For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.

abilities.name: WAY OF THE HUNTER
abilities.description: Yone deals magic damage with every second Attack. In addition, his critical strike chance is increased.

abilities.name: MORTAL STEEL
abilities.description: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line. On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel causes Yone to dash forward with a gust of wind, knocking enemies Airborne. Mortal Steel is treated as a basic Attack and scales with all the same things.

abilities.name: SPIRIT CLEAVE
abilities.description: Cleaves forward, damaging all enemies in a cone. Grants a shield to Yone. The shield's value is increased by the number of champions hit. Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with Attack Speed.

abilities.name: SOUL UNBOUND
abilities.description: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this skill ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.

abilities.name: FATE SEALED
abilities.description: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.

abilities.name: Contempt for the Weak
abilities.description: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds on the same target.

abilities.name: Razor Shuriken
abilities.description: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens. Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

abilities.name: Living Shadow
abilities.description: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability. Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

abilities.name: Shadow Slash
abilities.description: Zed and his shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Death Mark
abilities.description: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After a few seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked. Zed leaves a shadow behind and can reactive Death Mark to switch places with this shadow.

abilities.name: Short Fuse
abilities.description: All of Ziggs’s abilities also damage structures. Periodically, his next ability deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

abilities.name: Bouncing Bomb
abilities.description: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

abilities.name: Satchel Charge
abilities.description: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after 4 seconds, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

abilities.name: Hexplosive Minefield
abilities.description: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and slowing. Successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage.

abilities.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
abilities.description: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away. When quick casting, the bomb will target the enemy with the lowest HP.

abilities.name: MORE SPARKLES!
abilities.description: Zoe's next basic attack after casting a spell deals bonus magic damage.

abilities.name: PADDLE STAR!
abilities.description: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

abilities.name: SPELL THIEF
abilities.description: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

abilities.name: SLEEPY TROUBLE BUBBLE
abilities.description: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

abilities.name: PORTAL JUMP
abilities.description: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.

abilities.name: GARDEN OF THORNS
abilities.description: When hitting enemies with Grasping Roots, Zyra spawns Thorn Spitters who fight for her. If it misses, a Thorn Spitter will spawn at the end of the root’s travel path instead. Thorn Spitters automatically attack Zyra’s target, dealing Magic Damage. Deadly Spines or Stranglethorns spawn additional Thorn Spitters for each extra enemy champion, large monster, or epic monster hit.

abilities.name: DEADLY SPINES
abilities.description: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. Zyra will also spawn a Thorn Spitter, dealing damage. For each enemy hit the number of Thorn Spitters will increase.

abilities.name: RAMPANT GROWTH
abilities.description: Zyra enrages all Thorn Spitters near her. Enraged Thorn Spitters’ duration get reset and they gain bonus Health and bonus Attack Damage.

abilities.name: GRASPING ROOTS
abilities.description: Zyra sends forth vines through the ground to ensnare her target, dealing Magic Damage and rooting enemies they come across. Zyra spawns a Thorn Spitter when the vines hit the first enemy, or after the skill is cast if no enemy is hit.

abilities.name: STRANGLETHORNS
abilities.description: Zyra summons a massive thicket at a target location, dealing Magic Damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts. When enemy champions are hit, a Thorn Spitter will spawn.
